name: Split Arcana (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus 6

Benefit: When the magus expends a point from his arcane pool to grant enhancement bonuses or properties to a weapon, he may split the bonuses between two weapons. This otherwise follows all the normal rules for the magus adding enhancement bonuses and properties to weapons.

Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana. Copyright 2011, Super Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
